biotools.summary: HAP-SAMPLE2 is a tool for simulating genotype-phenotype data, extending the original HAP-SAMPLE tool to handle population admixture and rare variant analysis. It is designed to facilitate power analyses and evaluate statistical learning methods in association studies.
